activity.notes: Koyah was a ranking chief of the Kunghit, the southern Haida division centered around Ninstints. ATLAS does not create a centralized 'Haida Tribes' state; the Activity uses his historically specific Kunghit Haida political community and the period in which European records document his leadership.

sources.title: KOYAH — Dictionary of Canadian Biography
sources.citation_text: The Dictionary of Canadian Biography identifies Koyah as a ranking chief of the Kunghit-Haidas, the southernmost Haida division, and documents his encounters during the late eighteenth century.
